Though the summer showed some moderating in price pressures, she said underlying inflation is still running around 2.5%-3%, "well above our 2% target, and the gap has shown little signs of closing." "The best I can say about underlying inflation this year is that it hasn't gotten worse," Paulson said in prepared remarks for a fintech conference in her home district.

articles.title: China confirms first AI talks with U.S. have taken place, hints at trade truce extension
articles.summary: BEIJING—China's Commerce Ministry confirmed Thursday that its senior trade negotiators had held their first talks with the U.S. Spokesperson He Yadong told reporters the two sides also discussed plans for reducing tariffs, and extending trade arrangements agreed in Kuala Lumpur last October.
